meta.project: Infynno MCAT Question Bank Generator v2.0

product_overview: Infynno MCAT Question Bank Generator v2.0 is a React-based question authoring and review workspace for generating, validating, managing, and exporting MCAT-style questions. The app supports guided generation, live streaming review, batch monitoring, an AI-validated queue, and a searchable question bank.
core_goals: Generate MCAT-style questions through a guided configuration flow
Review, edit, approve, or discard generated questions before saving them
Monitor completed and in-progress generation batches
Browse, filter, inspect, delete, and export questions in the bank
Review high-confidence AI-validated questions for promotion into the main bank
Switch between dark and light themes while navigating the workspace

features.name: Navigation and Theme Management

Navigate to / -> Click the Batches tab -> View batch activity
Navigate to / -> Click the Validated tab -> View AI-validated questions
Navigate to / -> Click the Question Bank tab -> View the question repository
